metadata.pr_title: fix: improve task management in _log_transaction_async to avoid database locks
metadata.pr_description: When running a Loop flow, more than one task to log_transaction would be added, causing `database is locked` error. This makes sure and outstanding tasks in the vertex are awaited before adding new ones.

review_planner.summary: The changes involve modifying the logging mechanism in the `Vertex` class and adjusting the order of operations in the `build_vertices` function in `chat.py`. The primary focus is on making `_log_transaction_async` an asynchronous function and ensuring it is awaited properly.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Verify there are no security vulnerabilities introduced by the changes, particularly around asynchronous logging and task handling.

tasks.title: Logic Review
tasks.description: Ensure the logic for building vertices and logging transactions is correct. Verify that the asynchronous logging does not introduce race conditions or other logical issues.

tasks.title: Performance Review
tasks.description: Assess the performance impact of the changes, especially the transition of `_log_transaction_async` to an asynchronous method and its usage in critical paths.

tasks.title: General Review
tasks.description: Check for any missing tests or documentation related to the changes. Ensure the code adheres to the project's coding standards and conventions.
